summary:
**AstroSwipe** makes astronomical discovery accessible through a simple, swipe-based citizen science app. Users explore infrared images from different observation periods, comparing changes in the sky to spot objects that move or behave unexpectedly. The goal is to help identify potential Planet X candidates, ultra-cool brown dwarfs and other unusual objects.

Built around the Planet X and SPHEREx challenge, the platform combines data from SPHEREx, Gaia, WISE and 2MASS. Users can flag interesting findings, compare detections with other participants and explore candidate objects in more detail. By turning complex astronomical data into an engaging experience, AstroSwipe gives the public a chance to contribute to real scientific discovery.
details:
A gamified, Tinder-style citizen science platform inspecting multi-epoch SPHEREx infrared sky patches to hunt for Planet X, brown dwarfs, and variable stars.
Live URL: https://astroswipe.select
